function.name: ogr_convert_format
function.description: Convert vector data formats (e.g., SHP to GeoJSON), supporting multiple input and output formats.

input_file.description: Input vector file path, supported formats: Shapefile(.shp), GeoJSON(.geojson), KML(.kml), GPX(.gpx), GML(.gml), CSV(.csv), etc.

output_file.description: Output file path, extension determines output format.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing output file.

function.name: ogr_reproject
function.description: Reproject vector data to a new coordinate reference system (SRS). Specify source and target SRS for transformation. Use EPSG codes or PROJ strings for SRS definitions.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing output file.

function.name: ogr_clip
function.description: Clip vector geometries to a specified bounding box, WKT, or datasource after potential reprojection.

clipdst.description: Clip destination: bounding box 'xmin ymin xmax ymax', WKT geometry, or datasource path.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing output file.

function.name: ogr_filter_sql
function.description: Filter vector data using an SQL query to select features.

sql.description: SQL statement to execute (e.g., 'SELECT * FROM layer WHERE field > 10').

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing output file.

function.name: ogr_filter_where
function.description: Filter vector data using a WHERE clause for attribute query.

where.description: Attribute query in SQL WHERE format (e.g., 'field > 10').

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing output file.

function.name: ogr_select_fields
function.description: Select specific fields to include in the output vector data.

select.description: Comma-separated list of field names (e.g., 'field1,field2'). Use quotes for names with spaces or commas.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing output file.

function.name: ogr_append
function.description: Append vector data to an existing layer in the output datasource.

input_file.description: Input vector file path to append.

output_file.description: Existing output file path to append to.

nln.description: Name of the target layer to append to.

function.name: ogr_get_info
function.description: Get detailed information about a vector datasource, including layers, features, schema, and optional SQL queries.

summary_only.description: Show summary information only (suppress feature listing).

where.description: Optional WHERE clause for attribute query.

function.name: raster_convert_format
function.description: Convert raster data to a different format, with optional creation options.

creation_options.description: Creation options as 'NAME=VALUE' pairs separated by commas (e.g., 'TILED=YES,COMPRESS=DEFLATE').

function.name: raster_subset
function.description: Extract a subset of the raster using georeferenced coordinates or pixel offsets.

projwin.description: Georeferenced subwindow as 'ulx uly lrx lry'.

srcwin.description: Pixel/line subwindow as 'xoff yoff xsize ysize'.

function.name: raster_resize
function.description: Resize the raster output to a specified size or scale.

outsize.description: Output size as 'xsize ysize' or percentages (e.g., '50% 50%').

function.name: raster_set_projection
function.description: Assign a projection to the output raster.

a_srs.description: Spatial reference system to assign (e.g., EPSG:4326).

function.name: raster_set_nodata
function.description: Set nodata value for output bands.

function.name: raster_reproject
function.description: Reproject raster data to a new coordinate reference system.

input_file.description: Input raster file path (multiple inputs separated by commas for mosaicking).

function.name: raster_resample
function.description: Resample raster to a new resolution using specified method.

function.name: raster_clip_cutline
function.description: Clip raster using a vector cutline datasource or WKT.

function.name: raster_get_info
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about a raster dataset, including metadata, statistics, and histograms.

function.name: raster_hillshade
function.description: Generate a hillshade raster from a DEM.

function.name: raster_slope
function.description: Generate a slope raster from a DEM, in degrees or percent.

percent.description: Output in percent instead of degrees.

function.name: raster_aspect
function.description: Generate an aspect raster from a DEM, showing direction of slope.

trigonometric.description: Output in trigonometric angles (0 east, increasing counter-clockwise).

zero_for_flat.description: Set flat areas to 0 instead of -9999.

function.name: raster_color_relief
function.description: Generate a color relief raster from a DEM using a color configuration file.

color_file.description: Color configuration text file path (elevation r g b lines).

output_file.description: Output color relief raster file path.

function.name: raster_build_overviews
function.description: Build or rebuild overviews (pyramids) for a raster dataset.

clean.description: Remove existing overviews before building new ones.

function.name: raster_build_vrt
function.description: Build a virtual raster (VRT) mosaic from multiple input rasters.

input_files.description: Comma-separated list of input raster file paths or text file with one per line.

tr.description: Target resolution 'xres yres' if resolution is user.

function.name: raster_nearblack
function.description: Convert near-black or near-white borders in raster to exact black/white or transparent.

output_file.description: Output raster file path (omit for in-place update).

white.description: Search for near-white instead of near-black.

function.name: raster_generate_contours
function.description: Generate vector contours (lines or polygons) from a raster DEM.

function.name: qgis_run_algorithm
function.description: Run a QGIS processing algorithm from command line, specifying parameters as JSON.

algorithm.description: Algorithm ID (e.g., native:buffer) or model file path.

function.name: coordinate_transform_proj
function.description: Perform forward or inverse coordinate transformation using proj.

input_coordinates.description: Input coordinates as 'x y' or longitude latitude in DMS/decimal.

function.name: coordinate_transform_cs2cs
function.description: Transform coordinates between two CRS using cs2cs.

input_coordinates.description: Input coordinates as 'lon lat' or in DMS.

function.name: las_get_info
function.description: Get information about a LAS/LAZ point cloud file.

function.name: las_convert
function.description: Convert or filter LAS/LAZ point cloud data.

function.name: h5_dump
function.description: Dump contents of an HDF5 file.

function.name: h5_list
function.description: List contents of an HDF5 file.

function.name: gps_convert_format
function.description: Convert GPS data between formats like GPX, KML.

function.name: gps_filter_tracks
function.description: Filter or manipulate GPS tracks (e.g., simplify, interpolate).

filter.description: Filter string (e.g., 'track,move=2h' to time-shift by 2 hours).

function.name: sql_execute_query
function.description: Execute SQL queries on an SQLite database.

query.description: SQL query to execute (e.g., 'SELECT * FROM table').

function.name: sql_import_csv
function.description: Import CSV data into an SQLite table.
